6.sense_relied_on: φόβον (fear) not φόνον (murder): the unready and weak 'unable to bear the fear of a great contest'. Emendation flagged for critic adjudication.

6.item: κατεψεύσαντο ἡμῶν Θυέστεια δεῖπνα καὶ Οἰδιποδείους μίξεις
6.sense_relied_on: they falsely accused us of Thyestean feasts and Oedipodean unions — the stock pagan slanders of cannibalism and incest
